name: Lying Leg Raise
description: Works the lower stomach: lying on your back with legs straight, lift both legs toward the ceiling and lower them slowly.

source.title: Lying Floor Leg Raise (Muscle & Strength)
source.note: Standard exercise, described in our own words for this library. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Lie on your back, legs straight, arms by your sides with palms down.
cues: Keep your lower back pressed into the floor.
Lower slowly; stop before your back arches.

prescription.note: Move slowly: about 2 seconds to lift or push and 2 seconds to lower, resting between exercises as needed.

keyframes.name: Legs down
keyframes.cue: Legs straight, hovering just above the floor.

keyframes.name: Lift
keyframes.cue: Raise both legs toward the ceiling.
